# `variant_get`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Extracts a sub-variant from `v` according to `path`, and then cast the sub-variant to `type`. When `type` is omitted, it is default to `variant`. Returns null if the path does not exist. Throws an exception if the cast fails.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
variant_get(v, path[, type])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- variant_get, example 1
> SELECT variant_get(parse_json('{"a": 1}'), '$.a', 'int');
1
```

```sql
-- variant_get, example 2
> SELECT variant_get(parse_json('{"a": 1}'), '$.b', 'int');
NULL
```

```sql
-- variant_get, example 3
> SELECT variant_get(parse_json('[1, "2"]'), '$[1]', 'string');
2
```

```sql
-- variant_get, example 4
> SELECT variant_get(parse_json('[1, "2"]'), '$[2]', 'string');
NULL
```

```sql
-- variant_get, example 5
> SELECT variant_get(parse_json('[1, "hello"]'), '$[1]');
"hello"
```
